connectionSpecification.description: Reads tables and views of a Snowflake database: full refresh, or incremental by a cursor column.

account.description: Account identifier, orgname-accountname or the account locator with its region (the part before .snowflakecomputing.com).
account.title: Account

credentials.description: How the connector logs in to Snowflake.

private_key.description: RSA private key in PEM (PKCS#8 or PKCS#1) whose public key is set as the user's RSA_PUBLIC_KEY.
private_key.title: Private Key

private_key_password.description: Password of an encrypted PKCS#8 private key.
private_key_password.title: Private Key Password

username.description: The Snowflake user to log in as.
username.title: Username

credentials.title: Authentication

database.description: Database to read. The role needs USAGE on it.

role.description: Role of the session. When empty, the user's default role.
role.title: Role

schemas.description: Schemas to sync, as Snowflake stores their names (unquoted names are upper case). When empty, every schema of the database.
schemas.title: Schemas

warehouse.description: Warehouse that runs the queries. The role needs USAGE on it.
warehouse.title: Warehouse
